review.worst: OB basis 0 TP / 5 SL; longs 4 SL + 1 BE of 5, shorts 3 SL + 1 BE of 4; am 5 SL/2 BE, pm 2 SL. TP1 never reached in 9 fills.
review.note: WR 0% over 6 TP+SL, avg_r -0.75: no TP1 hit at all, so not a low-WR/high-RR case. 14.10 short was right in direction but stopped by the CPI spike inside the blackout. 15.10 am: first non-fill (NO_PULLBACK) - price reached TP1 1.41961 without touching entry 1.42290; entry 14 pips above price was too deep for a 5-pip pullback. 15.10 pm: second straight non-fill (DEEP_ENTRY) - stopped 3.0 pips short, the blackout touch at 14:35 would have paid TP1 +1.79R; 2 of the last 2 orders missed by entries set at the sweep level instead of the zone near edge. 16.10 am: third straight non-fill (NO_PULLBACK) - entry 16.8 pips above price at H1 LH 1.42020, real pullback only 1.6 pips (cap = London high 1.41868 / H1 OB wick), TP1/TP2 then traded. 3 of the last 3 orders missed with entries 15-17 pips from price, while the moves themselves would have paid. 20.10 pm: fourth straight non-fill (NO_PULLBACK) - TP1 traded 10 minutes after creation, entry 26 pips away never approached closer than 14.3 pips. 21.10 pm: the one shallow entry that DID fill (OB 11:00, no sweep before it, RR 1.14) was run over by an H1 body close 18 pips through the zone - ZONE_FAILED #4; shallow fills on unswept OBs fail, deep entries don't fill.
review.proposal: Limit only in the direction of the last H1 BOS AND only on an OB that swept a pool >= 3 pips right before its impulse; entry at the zone's near edge (not the far sweep level), max 3 pips beyond the obvious EQH/EQL.
